# WorkBuddy Skill Atlas

> Search public Agent Skills and adapt reviewed workflows for WorkBuddy. Every catalog record links to an immutable GitHub commit. Indexed content is not automatically trusted or installed.

## Use the catalog

- Web search: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/
- Chinese search: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/zh-CN.html
- Compact JSON catalog: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/catalog.json
- Catalog metadata: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/catalog-meta.json
- Source repository: https://github.com/sandbaseai/workbuddy-skill
- Adaptation guide: https://github.com/sandbaseai/workbuddy-skill/blob/main/docs/adapting-skills.md
- Chinese adaptation guide: https://github.com/sandbaseai/workbuddy-skill/blob/main/docs/adapting-skills.zh-CN.md

## Safety and provenance

The Atlas stores metadata, immutable source links, compatibility signals, and conservative static review signals. A clean signal is not a security guarantee. Review the original license, instructions, bundled resources, scripts, network behavior, and permissions before adapting or installing any Skill.

## Local query

Clone the repository and run:

```bash
python3 scripts/query_catalog.py research --security no-static-flags --source-context primary-looking --min-score 80 --unique --sort score --limit 10
```

Use `--json` for machine-readable results. Search terms are combined, so every term must match the repository, path, or inferred skill name. Filters are available for WorkBuddy status, static review state, minimum score, unique blob SHA, and result ordering.

## Adapt a reviewed result

```bash
python3 scripts/adapt_skill.py \
  --catalog-id 'github:owner/repository:path/to/SKILL.md' \
  --display-name-zh '中文名称' \
  --display-name-en 'English name' \
  --description-zh '中文说明' \
  --description-en 'English description' \
  --author 'Original author; WorkBuddy adapter' \
  --source-license 'MIT'
```

The adapter does not execute downloaded content. It records provenance, applies size and path limits, statically scans instructions and referenced scripts, and packages referenced resources from the same immutable commit.
